purpose: Confirm use of ordered two-frame evidence in frozen pooled features, separate from static position priors; not a memory architecture result.

data.seed_scheme: first 8 bytes little-endian of SHA256(v5-temporal-confirm-1/role/block), NumPy default_rng; no rejection sampling or reseeding

confirmation.release: only after FIT selection, weights, source and receipts are frozen

original_distribution_bridge.freshness: executor must attest no previous access; if violated stop and revise the registration before any score

data.nuisance: same colors, glyphs, static yellow distractor, background and shutter state within every block

encoder.unique_image_rule: encode each of the three images exactly once and reuse identical tensors for all views and [C,C]; no separately batched anchor copies
encoder.raw_role: optional secondary diagnosis; raw scores cannot satisfy the pooled prerequisite

reader.quadratic_definition: (1+Train-centered trace-normalized linear Gram)^2, then Train-only RKHS center and trace-normalize again
reader.regularization: solve K + n_fit * mean_loss_alpha * I in FP64; this grid equals the diagnostic alpha grid divided by 128, not its diagonal-lambda convention

cv.group: all four views of a block
cv.objective: four-dimension motion normalized MSE against each fitting fold's target mean; equally average four held-fold losses
cv.tie_break: lowest loss, linear before quadratic, then larger mean_loss_alpha

reader.single_frame_controls: t6-only and t7-only, each given exactly the same two kernels, six penalties, folds and objective; report both, do not select by confirmation
reader.selection_data: new FIT blocks only; no old Dev or new confirmation labels
freeze_before_confirmation: all fold scores and block assignments
fitted coefficients/Train moments and their hashes

primary_endpoints.contrast_skill: per coordinate 1 - mean((predicted_contrast-d)^2)/mean(d^2); zero contrast is the structural single-frame null
primary_endpoints.absolute_motion_skill: mean of four coordinate skills over all four views, against zero displacement (the exact balanced FIT mean)
primary_endpoints.acceptance: all eight coordinate contrast lower bounds AND absolute mean motion lower bound > 0; position skill against frozen FIT mean > 0.1

bootstrap.method: Bonferroni-adjusted one-sided percentile bootstrap; approximate finite-sample coverage, conditional on frozen reader

numerical_invariants.meaning: consistency checks for a reader trained on exactly reversal-balanced views; not evidence of information on their own

bridge_acceptance.motion_skill: mean Train-mean-baseline skill has one-sided 95% paired-world bootstrap lower bound >0; every coordinate point skill >0
bridge_acceptance.interpretation: Checks transfer back to original task geometry/reflections; does not independently prove temporal use. Primary quartet confirmation supplies that evidence.

stopping_rule: Single locked primary reader, fixed counts, one confirmation report. Any failed prerequisite stops P0. No winner switching, seed hunting, block top-up, threshold change, or Test consultation.
integration: Sidecar primitives only. No GPU extraction runner or production-gate override is provided. Local executor independently reviews and freezes a new runner commit before any future authorized execution; original V5 remains failed.
